title: Wendell and the Salt
author: Juniper Dunmore
blurb: Freya Quintana, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
